props.animation_script:
// ============================================================================

// Downburst (Gryphon Zero Power) - Sequencer (Pipeline Version)

// - Uses __PAYLOAD from your Action System when available

// - Macro ENDS immediately after cinematic (no awkward pause)

// - Camera pans WITH gust burst

// - Adds DAMAGE SFX at the very end (right before animationEnd emit)

// ============================================================================

(async () => {

const TAG = "[Downburst]";

try {

if (!game.modules.get("sequencer")?.active) {

ui.notifications.error("Sequencer module is not active.");

return;

}

// Minimal ONI.emit helper (Ruinous Breath style)

globalThis.ONI = globalThis.ONI ?? {};

if (!ONI.emit) {

ONI.emit = function (eventName, payload = {}, options = {}) {

const { local = true, world = false } = options;

if (local) Hooks.callAll(eventName, payload);

if (world) game.socket.emit("world", { action: eventName, payload });

};

}

// --- Payload ---

const payload = globalThis.__PAYLOAD ?? {};

// --- Helpers ---

const isUuid = (v) => typeof v === "string" && v.includes(".");

async function resolveToken(ref) {

if (!ref) return null;

if (ref?.document && ref?.object) return ref;

if (ref?.id && canvas.tokens?.get(ref.id)) return canvas.tokens.get(ref.id);

if (isUuid(ref)) {

const doc = await fromUuid(ref);

if (!doc) return null;

if (doc.object) return doc.object;

if (doc.document?.object) return doc.document.object;

return null;

}

if (typeof ref === "string") return canvas.tokens.get(ref) ?? null;

return null;

}

function pickTargetsFromPayload(p) {

if (Array.isArray(p.targetTokenIds) && p.targetTokenIds.length) return p.targetTokenIds;

if (Array.isArray(p.targets) && p.targets.length) {

const out = [];

for (const t of p.targets) {

if (typeof t === "string") out.push(t);

else if (t?.tokenId) out.push(t.tokenId);

else if (t?.tokenUuid) out.push(t.tokenUuid);

}

return out.filter(Boolean);

}

if (Array.isArray(p.rows)) {

const out = [];

for (const r of p.rows) {

if (r?.targetTokenId) out.push(r.targetTokenId);

if (r?.targetTokenUuid) out.push(r.targetTokenUuid);

}

if (out.length) return out;

}

return [];

}

// --- Resolve caster & targets ---

const sourceRef =

payload.sourceTokenUuid ??

payload.sourceTokenId ??

payload.casterTokenUuid ??

payload.casterTokenId ??

payload.attackerTokenUuid ??

payload.attackerTokenId ??

null;

const targetRefs = pickTargetsFromPayload(payload);

// Fallbacks for testing

const fallbackSource = canvas.tokens.controlled[0] ?? null;

const fallbackTargets = Array.from(game.user.targets ?? []);

const sourceToken = (await resolveToken(sourceRef)) ?? fallbackSource;

const targets = [];

for (const r of targetRefs) {

const tok = await resolveToken(r);

if (tok) targets.push(tok);

}

if (!targets.length && fallbackTargets.length) targets.push(...fallbackTargets);

if (!sourceToken) {

ui.notifications.warn("Downburst: No caster token (payload missing and nothing selected).");

return;

}

if (!targets.length) {

ui.notifications.warn("Downburst: No targets (payload missing and nothing targeted).");

return;

}

// --- Broadcast start ---

ONI.emit(

"oni:animationStart",

{

type: "zpDownburst",

sourceTokenId: sourceToken.id,

targetTokenIds: targets.map((t) => t.id),

sceneId: canvas.scene?.id ?? null,

timestamp: Date.now(),

},

{ local: true, world: false }

);

// --- Assets ---

const DIM_IMAGE = "https://assets.forge-vtt.com/610d918102e7ac281373ffcb/ScreenDimmer.png";

const SFX_CAST = "https://assets.forge-vtt.com/610d918102e7ac281373ffcb/Sound/Flash2.ogg";

const SFX_WIND = "https://assets.forge-vtt.com/610d918102e7ac281373ffcb/Sound/Soundboard/Wind1.ogg";

const SFX_DAMAGE = "https://assets.forge-vtt.com/610d918102e7ac281373ffcb/Sound/Soundboard/Damage5.ogg";

const VFX_FEATHER =

"modules/JB2A_DnD5e/Library/Generic/Nature/SwirlingFeathersOutburst03_01_Regular_Textured_400x400.webm";

const VFX_GUST =

"modules/JB2A_DnD5e/Library/2nd_Level/Gust_Of_Wind/GustOfWind_01_White_VeryFast_1200x200.webm";

// --- Tunables ---

const dimAlpha = 0.6;

const dimFade = 250;

const zoomDuration = 650;

const resetDuration = 650;

const zoomScaleMult = 1.75;

const featherScale = 1.0;

const gustScale = 3.0;

const castDelay = 150;

// KEY: make pan duration match gust duration, so camera “rides” the wind

const gustBurstDuration = 1200;

const panDuration = gustBurstDuration;

// --- Camera baseline ---

const originalView = canvas.getViewPosition

? canvas.getViewPosition()

: { x: canvas.stage.pivot.x, y: canvas.stage.pivot.y, scale: canvas.stage.scale.x };

const casterCenter = sourceToken.center;

const farthestX = Math.max(...targets.map((t) => t.center.x));

const panEnd = { x: farthestX, y: casterCenter.y };

// --- Dimmer (persist, NON-BLOCKING) ---

new Sequence()

.effect(DIM_IMAGE)

.atLocation(sourceToken)

.scale(40)

.belowTokens()

.opacity(dimAlpha)

.persist()

.name("oni-downburst-dimmer")

.fadeIn(dimFade)

.fadeOut(dimFade)

.play();

// --- MAIN CINEMATIC (await only this) ---

const seq = new Sequence();

// 1) Zoom in to caster

seq.canvasPan()

.atLocation(casterCenter)

.duration(zoomDuration)

.scale(originalView.scale * zoomScaleMult)

.waitUntilFinished();

// Cast sound right as zoom settles

seq.sound().file(SFX_CAST).volume(0.9).delay(castDelay);

seq.wait(castDelay);

// 2) Feather burst at caster

seq.effect().file(VFX_FEATHER).atLocation(sourceToken).scale(featherScale).opacity(1.0);

// 3) START CAMERA PAN NOW so it moves WITH the gust

seq.canvasPan()

.atLocation(panEnd)

.duration(panDuration)

.scale(originalView.scale * 1.25);

// 4) Gust SFX + ONE big gust (wait on gust)

seq.sound().file(SFX_WIND).volume(0.9);

seq.effect()

.file(VFX_GUST)

.atLocation(sourceToken)

.stretchTo(panEnd)

.scale(gustScale)

.opacity(1.0)

.duration(gustBurstDuration)

.waitUntilFinished(0.15);

seq.wait(50);

// 5) Reset camera

seq.canvasPan()

.atLocation({ x: originalView.x, y: originalView.y })

.duration(resetDuration)

.scale(originalView.scale)

.waitUntilFinished();

await seq.play();

// --- End dimmer (non-blocking) ---

if (globalThis.Sequencer?.EffectManager) {

Sequencer.EffectManager.endEffects({ name: "oni-downburst-dimmer" });

}

// --- Play DAMAGE SFX at the end (requested) ---

// Using Sequencer sound keeps timing consistent with other SFX

new Sequence()

.sound()

.file(SFX_DAMAGE)

.volume(0.95)

.play();

// --- Emit END immediately so damage ticks NOW ---

ONI.emit(

"oni:animationEnd",

{

type: "zpDownburst",

sourceTokenId: sourceToken.id,

targetTokenIds: targets.map((t) => t.id),

sceneId: canvas.scene?.id ?? null,

timestamp: Date.now(),

},

{ local: true, world: false }

);

console.log(TAG, "END");

} catch (err) {

console.error(`${TAG} Animation crashed:`, err);

// Still emit animationEnd so pipeline won't hang

try {

globalThis.ONI?.emit?.("oni:animationEnd", { type: "zpDownburst", error: true, timestamp: Date.now() }, { local: true });

} catch (_) {}

}

})();
